This beans plot is very small, just a corner of my land. Beans do not need much fertilizer because they put nitrogen into the soil themselves, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for such a tiny piece — it is not worth the money. I will use seeds I saved from last season like my neighbors do, and I will put some manure from the household if I can gather it. My wife and I can handle the weeding and harvesting ourselves on such a small plot, no need to hire anyone.
